refnamediv.refpurpose: Construct a new CachingIterator object for the iterator

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
iterator
The iterator to cache.
flags
A bitmask of the CachingIterator constants.
At most one of CachingIterator::CALL_TOSTRING, CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_KEY, CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_CURRENT and CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_INNER may be given. It selects what CachingIterator::__toString returns; if none of them is given, calling it throws an exception.
CachingIterator::FULL_CACHE keeps every element that has been iterated over, so that it can be accessed with array syntax or retrieved with CachingIterator::getCache.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a ValueError if flags contains more than one of CachingIterator::CALL_TOSTRING, CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_KEY, CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_CURRENT and CachingIterator::TOSTRING_USE_INNER.

&reftitle.notes;
With CachingIterator::CALL_TOSTRING, which is the default, each element is converted to a &string; as soon as the iterator moves to it, whether or not CachingIterator::__toString is ever called. An element that is an &array; raises an E_WARNING, and an object that does not implement __toString() throws an Error. To iterate over such elements, pass flags that do not contain CachingIterator::CALL_TOSTRING, such as 0.
